title: MMDA to void Nov. 2-7 NCAP tickets on stretch of EDSA Busway

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Motorists who cited for No Contact Apprehension Policy (NCAP) violations for using a specific stretch of the Edsa Busway from Nov. 2 to Nov. 7 will have their tickets canceled, the Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) said on Tuesday. The cancellations cover private vehicles caught traversing the busway section between Nepa Q-Mart and Boni Avenue during the period. In an advisory posted on social media, the MMDA said motorists who received a Notice of Violation may contest their tickets, which the agency will automatically cancel.
